subject: Q3 priorities: cross-functional calibration and exec review
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 priorities: draft OKRs + ask for calibration

Team — attaching the first pass at Q3 OKRs for the product + platform org. I pulled together the top-line ambitions we discussed in the leadership offsite and mapped them to measurable indicators.

Highlights: 
- Goal A: Reduce median tail latency by 30% for hosted API (performance + infra levers).
- Goal B: 25% reduction in per-token cost for high-volume customers via batching + quantization.
- Goal C: Launch Dedicated GA with 3 pilot customers and SLA baseline.

Ask: please review the sheet (Q3_OKR_draft.xlsx) and add comments inline by EOD Thursday. I want to run a short calibration session with execs on Friday at 3pm PT before we lock the OKRs for the QBR packet.

Notes: I flagged a couple of open decisions in the sheet — owner/metric pairings and whether we include a soft target for model-mix that trades quality for cost.

For context I'm copying the QBR agenda draft (QBR_agenda_v1.pdf) link in case you want to see how these map to the executive readout.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_OKR_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB); QBR_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 90KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 priorities: draft OKRs + ask for calibration

Thanks Markus — quick pass below and I left comments in the sheet. Short summary: 

1) Latency goal: agree on the 30% tail number but recommend splitting by tier (hosted API vs dedicated pools) so SLO owners can set tactical plans.
2) Cost reduction: suggest making the metric "effective per-token cost" (includes infra + egress) rather than raw GPU cycles; keeps finance and pricing aligned.
3) GA pilots: list of two priority customers I recommend for the Dedicated pilot — I'll intro privately.

On the model-mix soft target: don't lock a single % yet — allow engineering experiments in Q3 and include an eval gating criterion.

-Karthik

Subject: Re: Q3 priorities: draft OKRs + ask for calibration

Folks — added inline targets and a short risks column in the sheet. Two quick calls out: 

- For Goal B (cost): propose a secondary metric that captures perceived quality (sampled eval set) so we don't regress user experience while optimizing cost. I put a placeholder: "SLO-quality-retention >= 95%".
- For Goal C (Dedicated GA): suggest we include an operational readiness checklist (backup region, infra runbook, incident playbook) as a pre-req for GA call.

If leadership wants shorter discussion Friday, we can pre-align asynchronously on the three decision points: split latency by tier, cost metric definition, and GA readiness checklist.

-Mina

Markus — thanks for circulating. From an exec-readout perspective I want two small edits: 

1) Make the customer impact statements more explicit under each goal (one sentence each). Execs respond to customer delta + signal of business impact.
2) Add a contingency ask column — what we will ask for if we need a one-time credit or pilot discount to secure a Dedicated customer for GA. Put that as an optional collateral item.

I'll join Friday and can help run the 15-minute decision window Karthik suggested. If we keep the pre-work tight, we should be able to lock the OKRs in that slot.

Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the fast turns and the edits — I merged the decisions we agreed on into the sheet and uploaded an updated packet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4qOKRdoc (see tab "Final for Exec").

Summary of changes we will present Friday: 
- Split latency target by tier (hosted vs dedicated) and call out owners for each SLO.
- Adopt "effective per-token cost" as the primary cost metric; include SLO-quality-retention >= 95% as a guardrail.
- Dedicated GA: require operational readiness checklist; list of proposed pilots appended (Karthik to intro).

Friday 3:00–3:45pm PT — exec calibration slot confirmed; Laura is running the decision window. Please be online 5 minutes early.

Next steps: I will finalize the QBR packet after Friday and send the header slide to the execs Monday morning. If anyone wants to escalate any open tradeoffs beforehand, flag them on the drive doc (see JIRA: REDWOOD-8723).

Markus
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
